before_results.readmission: Positive class is patient readmitted within 30 days; false alarm is more costly to the hospital based on the follow up that may occur. If a patient is missed to be flagged for readmission it won't matter because they can still get readmitted and receive the care they would need.
before_results.diabetes: Positive class is Diabetes (reported doctor diagnosis or HbA1c ≥ 6.5%); missed positive is more costly to the patient's health overall because there can be serious consequences to missing a diabetes diagnosis related to the impacts the disease has on the body when not treated.
